# Customer case template v1

> Publish only a real, customer-approved case. Remove every unused field; never fill gaps with inferred numbers or marketing claims.

## Editorial status

- Customer approval: pending / approved
- Permission to name the customer: yes / no
- Evidence owner:
- Evidence references:
- Publication reviewer:
- Review date:

## Public case

### Title

`[Type of organization]: [factual procurement or equipment outcome]`

### Initial task

- Organization type:
- Region (only if approved):
- Required equipment/category:
- Source requirement or technical specification:
- Constraints confirmed by evidence:

### Work completed

- Selection method:
- Requirements checked:
- Alternatives considered:
- Documents prepared or supplied:

### Result

- Delivered scope:
- Confirmed outcome:
- Date or period:
- Quantitative facts with evidence only:

### Customer quote

Include only a written, approved quote with attribution agreed by the customer.

### Call to action

`Отправить техническое задание` → `/request`

## Prohibited without evidence

- invented savings, delivery time, quantities, client counts or performance;
- customer name, logo, employee names or procurement details without approval;
- “official dealer”, “best”, “№1”, guarantees or universal service claims;
- personal data or confidential commercial terms.
